label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: A newsletter sign-up modal covered the page and blocked clicks on the product link; both consent checkboxes in it were pre-ticked, so I had to find and press close modal first.

Each product card dumps its full marketing text into one huge text blob in the tree, with several identical Shop Now and Learn More buttons that have no product name, so I could not tell which button belongs to which product.

After pressing Add to Cart there was no clear confirmation: the button turned into an unnamed disabled button, and the cart drawer only showed up later. The first click on Shopping cart timed out. Also the page says [name]-order with shipping on [name]. 15-25, which is a past date and confusing.
Many image links and buttons are named This is Product Image, and many buttons and links have no name at all (quantity plus and minus, close, cart item buttons), so they cannot be told apart.

The email news-and-offers box is pre-ticked, and the cart drawer had an extra paid Worry-Free Purchase service line plus a Plus membership upsell; there is also a lot of promo noise before the checkout button.
